title: Immunofluorescence Staining Protocol for Fetuin-A and GFAP Co-Staining
author: Miriam Heinen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.syeefte
materials: Encircle tissue section with wax pen

Tip off excess solution and apply the primary antibodies MAHS-1 (dilution 1 µg/ml) and Anti-GFAP (dilution 1:50) in 1% BSA in PBS, 100 µl per section (negative controls: only 1% dilution), incubation overnight in a moisture chamber

Apply the secondary antibodies: biotinylated goat-anti-mouse antibody (dilution 1:300) and polyclonal goat-anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor® 488 conjugated secondary antibody (dilution 1:300), both in 1% of BSA in PBS, 100 µl per section, incubation for 90 minutes at room temperature in a moisture chamber. keep the tissue samples from now on light protected!

steps.title: Hybridization oven incubation
steps.instruction: Place slides in a hybridization oven at 37 °C overnight, then increase to 65 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene for three rounds of 20 minutes each on a shaker, using three separate containers.

steps.title: Rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Rehydrate through graded ethanol: 100 % ethanol for three × 2 min, 96 % ethanol for two × 2 min, then 70 % ethanol for 2 min.

steps.title: PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in citrate buffer (10 mM, pH 6) in a heat steamer for 30 minutes, then let them cool in PBS for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Second PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Apply 10 % goat serum in PBS, incubate in a moisture chamber for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Tip off excess blocking solution and rinse slides in demineralized water.
Wash in PBS three times for 5 minutes each.
Tip off excess solution again and rinse in demineralized water.
Wash in PBS three times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Prepare TSA kit components
steps.instruction: Prepare the components of the Tyramide Signal Amplification Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Apply HRP solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the pre‑prepared HRP solution 1:100 in 1 % BSA/PBS, apply 100 µL per section, and incubate 1 hour at room temperature in a moisture chamber.

substeps.instruction: Tip off excess solution and rinse in demineralized water.
Wash in PBS three times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Prepare tyramide working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the tyramide stock 1:100 in a 0.0015 % hydrogen peroxide solution as described by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Apply tyramide solution
steps.instruction: Apply 100 µL of the tyramide working solution per section and incubate for 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Tip off excess solution and rinse in demineralized water.
Wash in PBS three times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Lipofuscin quenching
steps.instruction: Counterstain with Sudan Black (0.3 % in 70 % ethanol) for 5 minutes to reduce lipofuscin autofluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Rinse slides with demineralized water until the solution is clear and colorless.
Wash in demineralized water three times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: DAPI counterstain
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with DAPI (0.25 µg/mL) for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Wash in PBS three times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Store slides
steps.instruction: Store the stained slides at 8 °C in the dark until imaging.
